summary: Creating OAuth credentials is quick, but Google's approval story is the heavy one: anything beyond non-sensitive scopes needs formal verification, and restricted scopes take about 6 weeks plus a security assessment. Unverified apps are capped at 100 new users.

approval.typical_timeline: Brand verification 2-3 business days; sensitive-scope verification ~10 business days; restricted-scope verification ~6 weeks plus a security assessment (Google's published estimates, not guaranteed).
approval.notes: Apps using only non-sensitive scopes skip verification, but then only your domain (not app name/logo) shows on the consent screen. Restricted scopes also need annual re-verification.

steps.title: Create a Google Cloud project and configure the consent screen
steps.detail: In Google Cloud Console, open the Google Auth Platform, set app name, user support email, and audience (external for public apps).

steps.title: Add scopes and check their category
steps.detail: Cloud Console labels each scope non-sensitive, sensitive, or restricted automatically. This category drives whether verification is mandatory.

steps.title: Create OAuth client credentials
steps.detail: Create an OAuth 2.0 Client ID (web, iOS, Android, etc.) with authorized redirect URIs.

steps.title: Prepare verification materials if you use sensitive or restricted scopes
steps.detail: Production external apps need a homepage on a verified domain, a privacy policy on the same domain linked from the homepage and the consent screen, and terms links. You cannot submit for verification without them.

steps.title: Submit for verification and respond to review findings
steps.detail: Brand verification can complete in minutes to 2-3 business days. Sensitive scope review averages ~10 business days; restricted ~6 weeks plus a third-party security assessment. Failed checks appear in a View issues panel; you can fix and re-verify or request additional review.

nuances: Unverified apps using sensitive/restricted scopes show an 'unverified app' warning and are capped at 100 new users; hitting the cap can disable Google sign-in.
Compliant verification results expire in 7 days if you do not publish the branding.
Changing app name, logo, or URLs on a verified app creates a new draft that needs re-verification.
agent_can_do: Classify your scopes by sensitivity and predict which verification tier applies
Draft the privacy policy and homepage checklist against Google's stated requirements
Track the verification status and interpret View issues findings
human_must_do: Own the Google Cloud project and verified domain
Submit the verification request from your console
Complete the security assessment for restricted scopes
